gen-flavors-gf-days-one: Whimsical diagonals in Flavors carry as much heft as its stems, while the sans-serif Days One fills each line with rope-ladder spacing. Both are loud about their lowercase.
gen-flavors-gf-farro: Whimsical, pencil-stub lowercase gives Flavors its swagger, with diagonals as heavy as the stems. Farro, a sans-serif with compressed ascenders and no stroke contrast, is the plain counterweight that holds it steady.
gen-flavors-gf-fragment-mono: Flavors arrives whimsical and commanding, its towering lowercase and sturdy diagonals made for attention. And Fragment Mono, a monospace body, lines its precise letters up like nails on a ruler beneath that noise.
gen-flavors-gf-genos: Tubelike, constant-weight lines give Flavors its whimsical, commanding look, diagonals and stems alike. Genos, a plain sans with a pen-steady stroke and tight spacing, would read smoothly down a full page without snagging.
gen-flavors-gf-geom: Geom reads friendly and contemporary, a plain sans with a lofty lowercase band. And Flavors, drawn with a marker's constant-width line, adds a whimsical, commanding shout above it.
gen-flavors-gf-inder: Commanding, stencil-cut letters of a steady width give Flavors its whimsical punch above the text. And Inder, a sans with little height difference between cases, would carry a full page of reading smoothly.
gen-flavors-gf-major-mono-display: Flavors is whimsical and commanding, its diagonals carrying the same heft as its stems. Major Mono Display, a monospace with neon-glass strokes and wide sidebearings, would read slowly and precisely, line after line.
gen-flavors-gf-martian-mono: Loud lettering up top, loose code-style spacing below. Flavors brings whimsical, stubby-pencil lowercase and sturdy diagonals, while Martian Mono, a monospace, spaces every letter far apart with generous curve openings.
gen-flavors-gf-menbere: Menbere reads clean, a plain sans with lowercase stacked like rolled cord. Flavors, whimsical and commanding with every stroke at one thickness, makes the pair's loudest, clearest difference.
gen-flavors-gf-momo-trust-display: Flavors twists whimsical, commanding letterforms like bent tubing, diagonals and stems all matching in heft. Momo Trust Display, a sans-serif with drifting letters and a generous x-height, would read openly across a full page.
